tools.name: generate_invoice_ledger
tools.description: Use this when the user wants several invoices in one spreadsheet ("put these invoices into Excel", "invoice log from these PDFs", "purchase ledger", "VAT summary by rate", "check these invoices for duplicates"). Send the invoices as rows when their values are in the chat or a screenshot; send attach

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: generate_invoice_ledger · Private data: generate_invoice_ledger · Public sink: generate_invoice_ledger.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: generate_invoice_ledger · Private data: generate_invoice_ledger · Public sink: generate_invoice_ledger

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
